title_en: Complete task from dual-arm assembly through embryo dual-view time series and archiving

provenance.title: Dual-view plane illumination microscopy for rapid and spatially isotropic imaging
provenance.main_version: Green OA NIH/HHS author accepted manuscript; NOT publisher version of record
provenance.rights: Only newly authored facts, task specifications, and provenance links. Do not redistribute source PDFs, images, video, archives, or source code.

goal_for_agent: Using authorized virtual diSPIM parts and routine materials, deliver paired, traceable, quality-checked embryo dual-view time series and reconstruction results; leave the instrument and bench in a safe closeout state.

initial_state.world: Newly authored static bench; commercial light-source option; heavy optical table installed externally; no real lasers, power supplies, biological materials or animals
initial_state.instrument: The frame, lower observation path, dual-arm module, cameras and chamber are assemblable parts; camera identities and interface labels are readable
initial_state.consumables: Virtual stocks of clean coverslips, O-rings, markers, beads and dye; authorized preparation scene representing routine worm stocks
initial_state.training_clock: Virtual timers and cross-stage checkpoints; no claim that real days or physical time compression have been implemented
initial_state.unknowns: The sample XY-stage model, mechanical fits, torque, real drivers and robot specifications are unknown; use explicitly authored placeholder interfaces without inferring paper geometry

ordered_stage_contracts: Check component identities and safety boundaries
Establish component identities, modes, non-real-operation boundaries and provenance records
Correctly associate the frame, Z axis, mirror cube, filters, tube lens, bottom camera, 10x objective and XY stage
Connect and check three cameras and dual-arm controls
Connect with power off; check channel mapping and identity individually; save virtual test evidence
Verify coverslip orientation and chamber sealing; record XY/Z references rather than supplying a preset winning pose
Maintain symmetric arms without swapping identities; pass filter-orientation and optical-connectivity checks
Validate objective models, A/B axes, collision exclusion zones and observation positions
Virtual coating, waiting, washing and labeling actions leave state evidence
All three cameras show their corresponding preset optical feedback; assemblies have no unsupported connections
Closed-loop fine alignment and ROI centering
Adjust one control at a time from preset observations; save both arm offsets, camera ROIs and bottom-view localization image
Distinguish defocus, leading/lagging sheets, edge blur and aggregates; retain final dual-arm calibration
Complete both views, same-settings dark backgrounds, single-bead selections and unit traceability
Correctly fix the collection plane while scanning illumination; collect evidence at multiple positions in both arms
Routine embryo preparation and chamber loading
Record virtual isolation, transfer without mouth pipetting, central adhesion, orientation and stock provenance
Both views cover the target with complete sheet and volume coverage; do not compensate using synchronization-breaking Z offsets
Complete each pair of task-manifest timepoints without confusing backgrounds, parameters or data identities
Correctly pair A/B and timepoints; retain raw data and complete derived-file lineage
Select once, per-segment or per-timepoint registration from drift evidence; verify voxels, orientation, transforms and pairing
Check dual-view and reconstruction evidence, then archive, stop acquisition, withdraw samples and sort items; honestly report failed checks

hidden_from_agent: numeric success gates chosen by benchmark authors
completion_evaluator.numerical_result_policy: Evaluate task procedure and evidence, without requiring reproduction of the paper's FWHM, duration, embryo development or cell results. All images/readings are clearly labeled authored presets, not actual measurements.

source_step_coverage: All main steps 1–95 + 96A(i–xxiv) + 97–106, plus reagent/equipment setup and authored cleanup; the cell and custom launch alternatives are separately specified in the full family.
authored_sequence_note: The sequence is newly authored task topology, not a verbatim source copy. Every operation remains subject to its preconditions; diagnostic loops may return to relevant checkpoints.
